trigger_precision.rationale: Defines detection from RGB image plus query, and alternative when segmentation/semantic Q&A is preferable.

procedural_clarity.rationale: API call, normalized-to-pixel conversion and downstream choice are described with concrete parameters.

authority_and_safety.rationale: No per-call private-image egress consent/allowlist or sensitive-frame classification is visible in tool code; use of env key does not establish authority.

failure_handling.rationale: Empty/unparseable responses are indistinguishable from true no-match; box-order/finite checks missing and unknown scores default to 1.0.

evidence_discipline.rationale: Missing score/confidence is assigned 1.0, a false strongest-confidence signal, so evidence uncertainty is hidden.

dependency_coherence.rationale: All five in-package files read, including 35 resolved lock package records and exact local graph-as-policy-core editable path; external graph-as-policy-core implementation/API service behavior not verified.

portability_honesty.rationale: Explicit google-genai, API keys, host-specific SDK and Python 3.11 requirements; supports one external Gemini provider.

usefulness_differentiation.rationale: Useful bridge from object query to pixel-space bounding boxes and SAM3 prompt.

adversarial_resilience.rationale: Malformed/inverted/non-finite boxes and missing confidence can pass parsing; attacker-controlled query is included verbatim in remote prompt; no bounded egress authorization.

effectiveness_design.rationale: Mechanism is plausible but safety and trust calibration are insufficient; no end-to-end behavioral evidence.

findings.finding: Calls google-genai Client.models.generate_content with PNG-encoded camera image and untrusted query. No image-specific egress authorization/endpoint restriction in package; host protections not examined.
score defaults to 1.0 if missing, invalid or nonnumeric; fabricated maximum confidence may be chosen by downstream max(detections, key=score).
Box coordinates cast to floats then clamped without finite, monotonic, positive-area or confidence-range validation; inverted/malformed boxes may be represented as detections.
Unparseable model response yields empty detections, conflating malformed service output with true no match. Exceptions retain separate ToolError path.

Local editable external dependency ../../../graph-as-policy/gap-core is outside reviewed source tree; installation depends on neighbor checkout and security/authority controls are not established by this package.

remediations: Require scoped image-egress approval, permitted endpoint and privacy classification at dispatch boundary before sending any camera frame; prove host adapter enforces it.
Treat missing/unparseable scores as unknown confidence, never 1.0; validate score finite and in [0,1], sort only valid detections.
Reject nonfinite, inverted, zero-area or out-of-bounds detector coordinates rather than silently constructing plausible boxes.
Return distinct no_match, malformed_response and provider_error statuses with provenance of actual model result.
Bind/package-qualify external graph-as-policy runtime and destination SDK behavior; independently test adversarial query, score omissions and malformed boxes.

license.effective_scope: package-local MIT and root Apache-2.0 both observed; controlling scope and downstream bundled rights require context, no unconditional reuse claim

trigger_precision.rationale: Separates general VLM query and yes/no query and documents OpenRouter/Vertex routing.

procedural_clarity.rationale: Explicit provider routing, image encoding, retries and boolean parsing mechanisms.

authority_and_safety.rationale: No per-image/private-frame egress or provider-change authorization in package code; GAP_VLM_PROVIDER inherits GAP_LLM_PROVIDER and configurable GAP_VLM_BASE_URL can redirect image+bearer-key transmission.

failure_handling.rationale: Three retries for all exceptions can repeat transmissions/costs; ambiguous/no yes/no text is coerced to bool instead of a third UNKNOWN result.

evidence_discipline.rationale: Returns raw model text alongside boolean, a positive evidence practice; however substring fallback can manufacture yes from unrelated text.

dependency_coherence.rationale: All five in-package files read, including 35 resolved lock package records; external editable graph-as-policy-core and actual provider contracts unverified.

portability_honesty.rationale: Explicit OpenRouter/Vertex SDK and credential/provider config, Python 3.11, provider-specific default assumptions.

usefulness_differentiation.rationale: Encapsulates image Q&A and binary scene checks that can feed robot graphs.

adversarial_resilience.rationale: _coerce_yes_no uses first yes/no anywhere then substring yes fallback, susceptible to misleading response text; remote destination and token transport from inherited env are not explicitly constrained.

effectiveness_design.rationale: Useful architecture but high-consequence binary confidence and disclosed images lack robust failure-closed boundaries.

findings.finding: Sends PNG image bytes to selected hosted service without a visible per-image authorization gate; images may be sensitive camera observations.

Provider inherits GAP_LLM_PROVIDER and URL is controlled by GAP_VLM_BASE_URL; bearer token is attached to configured chat URL. Missing destination policy can redirect image+credential to unintended server. This is a configuration trust boundary, not proof maliciousness.

First standalone yes/no anywhere wins; absent standalone response falls back to substring yes in lowercased text (e.g., 'yesterday'), treating unrelated text as positive. Unknown/ambiguous response never yields UNKNOWN.
Retries every exception up to three calls, even nontransient errors; repeats potentially paid/private image transfer and logs exception strings whose redaction is not established.
External editable graph-as-policy-core is not exact-version bound by this source pin; outer authorization and data handling must be separately qualified.

remediations: Add explicit action-specific egress controls, endpoint allowlist, provider/account disclosure and consent for each relevant image context; avoid inheriting new provider for private data silently.
Constrain or disallow untrusted GAP_VLM_BASE_URL with API credentials, require expected origin/TLS and verified resolved provider.
Parse only a strict leading yes/no token (or structured constrained schema); route ambiguous/missing/untrusted model outputs to UNKNOWN and do not permit robot action on unknown.
Retry only classified transient cases with budget/authorization and redact sensitive exception/request data.
Pin and qualify external gap runtime/providers and add executed authorization-pressure/ambiguous-answer acceptance tests.
